title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
source: Recording Info: Recorded by Kidd at the soundboard - MAR > R > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Incredible audience recording with a smoking free‑form jam; high‑energy performance captured cleanly.
ai_review.review: The release is praised as “fucking incredible” and “awesome,” with listeners noting the masterful cleaning work that leaves the sound crystal clear despite being an audience source. The highlight is a long, space‑y jam where the band locks in so tightly that crowd chatter fades, delivering a high‑energy, captivating performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are 4–5 stars and emphasize both superb audio quality and an exceptional jam, indicating a strong show with excellent recording despite being audience‑sourced.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cleaned by 'kidd' – minimal crowd noise, clapping fades during the jam; overall crisp and clear FLAC24 mastering.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The performance flows naturally, with the long improvisational segment building momentum; audience engagement improves as the band deepens into the jam.
